description_en: Adds a topic mapping to a Global Replicator task
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq add-disaster-recovery-item --plan-id 1300000016 --topics deliveryOrderType=Concurrently consumerGroupId=GID_xxx instanceId=rmq-cn-em93y94xxx regionId=cn-hangzhou instanceType=ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ topicName=Topic_xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDisasterRecoveryItem

element_fields.help_en:
Instance type
  - ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ: Alibaba Cloud instance
  - EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ: External instance, open-source instance, open-source cluster
element_fields.help_zh:
实例类型
  - ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ ：阿里云实例
  - EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ ：外部实例，开源实例，开源集群
element_fields.name: instance_type

element_fields.help_en: Instance ID, an instance ID will be automatically generated when `instanceType` is `EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ`, and it can be obtained by querying the backup plan
element_fields.help_zh: 实例ID，instanceType为EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ会自动生成个实例ID，可以通过查询备份计划获取该ID
element_fields.name: instance_id

element_fields.help_en: Consumer group ID, required for ACTIVE_ACTIVE bidirectional backup
element_fields.help_zh: 消费者组ID，ACTIVE_ACTIVE双向备份时必填
element_fields.name: consumer_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The order in which messages are delivered to the target instance. The parameter values are as follows:
  - Concurrently: concurrent delivery
  - Orderly: sequential delivery
element_fields.help_zh:
消息投递到目标实例的顺序性。

参数取值如下：
- Concurrently：并发投递
- Orderly：顺序投递
element_fields.name: delivery_order_type

parameters.help_en: Topics included in the backup mapping. Required
parameters.help_zh: 备份映射所包含的主题，必填
parameters.name: topics
